mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost structure for Generative Engine Optimization services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost structure for GEO services can vary widely based on the scope of work, the size of your firm, and your current digital footprint. Services are typically offered on a retainer basis, project-based fees, or a combination. Factors influencing cost include the depth of content creation, technical SEO requirements, ongoing monitoring, and strategic consulting. A detailed proposal is usually provided after an initial assessment of your specific needs and goals.
